open_points_for_review: NCR-MEMORY-001: the pre-query partition is an explicit set of denied item identifiers in the live retrieval decision (decision_ref identifies the decision; the receipt does not list the items, so the audit_ref and the explanations do not depend on them); post-query drops of items the pre-query partition admitted (a revocation between planning and materialisation) keep the bounded page widening and RETRIEVAL_BACKPRESSURE of REM-0020

NCR-MEMORY-003: the contract enum gives no further semantics of LATEST_VERSION, PROJECT_SCOPE and PRINCIPAL_SCOPE; most restrictive reading recorded for the preventive review: LATEST_VERSION never resurrects an earlier version (the item ends DELETED), the bulk scopes forget only items visible to the caller and refuse the whole request before any write when one member is held, not forgettable or denied

NCR-MEMORY-004: getMemoryItemVersion has no request body; the caller's GovernedContext is the authenticated binding's (VerifiedGovernedContextBinding.expected) and its digest is recalculated at the boundary

NCR-MEMORY-002: the quota port of MemoryAdmissionService is a composition port (as the denial audit port of REM-0023): a composition is quota-bearing when it passes MemoryAdmissionQuota; the sealed and guarded consumer worlds that build the admission without it are unchanged; consolidation and every other admission caller inherit the quota of the admission they are given; MemoryQuotaWriter keeps its own hold and must not compose a second hold over the same serialization domain; an admitted but uncommitted version of an existing item makes the quota check refuse (HEAD_NOT_COMMITTED), and the admission/commit window of a new item belongs to the store commit, as for MemoryQuotaWriter (no cross-process admission claim)

NCR-MEMORY-005: the vector body of a native projection is not derivable from content and metadata alone (it is the embedding of the pinned model); the rebuild accepts it only as the exact embedding the item digests (embedding_digest and the pointer representation digest); the rebuild is a store-coordinator operation like reconcile (no new public route, no audit event of its own)
admission quota and admitted-but-uncommitted versions of new items (accepted residual 1): to be defended at the preventive review
open_points_resolved_during_the_unit: REM-0023 consumer-fixture guard: decision request NCP-U11-REM0023-CONSUMER-GUARD decided by the PO (option 1, 2026-11-09) and applied (8d7fee6)

product_orientation: the real memory adapters live in the package (ocor_runtime.memory.adapters), so the product composes PostgreSQL, Qdrant and OpenBao without test code
the pre-query policy partition is evaluated inside the PostgreSQL and Qdrant queries, so denied items cost no index work at production scale
quota is a trusted port of admitMemory, enforced under the PostgreSQL partition serialization before the atomic write
full-text and vector projections are rebuildable from the system of record, so an index loss is an operation, not a data loss
